transcript.query: How can I control it without chemicals?
transcript.reply: To manage Rice Armyworm / Swarming Caterpillar without synthetic chemicals: 1) Dig 30 cm deep trenches around the perimeter of the field and dust with lime or neem cake to trap marching caterpillars. 2) Flood the field briefly to force caterpillars out of soil crevices so birds can consume them. 3) Spray botanical Neem oil (Azadirachtin 1500 ppm) @ 3-5 ml/Litre.
